scope: MP0-MP6; optimized emitted behavior, host suite and saved-media audits; no release or real-hardware qualification
measurement_pairs: Two-element metrics are [before, after]. Identical observers add overhead; small frame differences include VBI alignment. COPY kernel counters are modulo 65536. Operations disable rotational delay; accurate SIO COPY does not. Default cache stays unchanged.

pin.scope: IDE Plus development checks only; not physical hardware qualification

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

pin.write_delay_basis: Figure 18 (1.0–1.8 ms); qualified only against these pinned disk models. Page 219 prose says 10–18 ms and is not used for these profiles.
pin.timeout_policy: One 250-tick active watchdog: ACK, result and data all inherit its remaining time; receiving a byte does not restart it. No separate phase or per-byte timeout in this disposable probe.

fault_responder.scope: Explicit D8 protocol/stop-bit corruption, test-only environment selector; POKEY and guest execute normally. Includes passive observer and drive-specific MOUNT patches.

emitted_native_routine_bytes.scope: Routine bodies in identically instrumented operation images; excludes constant data and packaged/release size.

storage.allocation_note: AllocMem rounds to eight bytes without a per-allocation prefix. Cursor/Entry are inline records; FileBacking owns the cursor. Every before/after size is identical.

bank_zero_reserved_delta.includes: guards, alignment and unused reserved capacity; no stack/DP or Task-pool change

limitations: Touched-byte stack observations are lower bounds, not proven worst-case depth; runtime/domain guards and ownership checks passed.
Focused 66000-byte write passed on Generic 57600 with explicit 512-block cache setting, equal to the current 64 KiB default.
Fastest 125 kbit/s 66000-byte probe failed readback with SIO checksum error 4 at sector 105; not transport qualification. No baseline established its cause.
Broad 71000-byte 128-byte-sector test stopped during repeated listings; successful focused large-file results are separate.
Repeated listing still measures every file chain. Byte-length caching, grouped directory/reclaim publication and buffer consolidation are deferred.
